test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rivers are lakes.

Some seas are rivers.

**Conclusion:**

I) Some seas are lakes.

II) All lakes are rivers.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
**Given statements:**

All rivers are lakes.

Some seas are rivers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0dbd810aa8e4b9d47fe05bbcbe534094c86e046c934142b1f3607da70524bf.png] 

Conclusion:

I) Some seas are lakes - **True** (Those parts of seas which is rivers will also lakes)

II) All lakes are rivers - False (It can be possible, but not definite)

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
